verdict.rationale: LegalZoom docs show registered-agent and annual-report services with deadline reminders and real-time compliance status alerts (docs-14, docs-16), which support timely annual report filing, but there's no explicit evidence of franchise tax filing/payment services on the platform. Missing for 10: franchise tax filing/payment capability, evidence of actual on-time filing outcomes, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the annual report filing process working as described.
